title: CanvasEditPro
description: CanvasEditPro is a simple yet powerful canvas editor for the web. Built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Fabric.js, it allows users to create, edit, and manage content on a customizable canvas.
features: Upload and position images on the canvas.
Insert and style text with various fonts, sizes, and colors.
Save your canvas as an image (PNG, JPEG).
